title: Army and Joint Force Claim Capture of Iyal Bakhit in West Kordofan
detail: Sudan's army and allied Joint Force said they took control of Iyal Bakhit in West Kordofan's El Khuwei locality on Nov 7 after clashes with the RSF, and shot down an RSF long-range drone. Fighting continued Nov 8 around Abu Minaiqir and near Um Kuraidim. Claims are from the army and allied forces and are not independently confirmed.
